title: More Jungle Saplings Redux
description: Sets jungle sapling drop rate to be the same as other trees
body:
This datapack restores the jungle sapling drop rate to the same as other trees.

By default, jungle leaves harvested with Fortune 3 have a lower sapling drop rate than any other tree with Fortune 0 (or natural decay). This results in most players getting negative returns on saplings.

The original drop rates for jungle saplings were:
- Fortune 0: 2.5%
- Fortune 1: 2.78%
- Fortune 2: 3.125%
- Fortune 3: 4.17%

This datapack changes the drop rates to mirror that of every other vanilla tree in the game:
- Fortune 0: 5%
- Fortune 1: 6.25%
- Fortune 2: 8.33%
- Fortune 3: 10%
